thread:
Amira (Finance): Heads-up: SunRidge Health (regional reseller) requested custom terms for a 3-month pilot: 10% usage rebate + Net60 invoicing. They also want VAT passthrough. Need deal-desk approval + legal.

Diego (Sales): Quick context: pilot targets two clinics, expected 60k tokens/mo ramp to 180k. Reseller says this concession is critical to win the account.

Tom (RevOps): Ops constraints: cap total rebate at EUR 6k, tie rebate to reseller account ID only, and require clawback if end-customer cancels within 45 days. We need a Zuora config ticket for a custom rebate charge and Net60 term.

Harper (Legal): OK to draft a short addendum. Will include definition of "rebate", expiration date, clawback formula, and VAT representations. Also recommend reseller provide valid VAT ID.

Amira (Finance): Approve in principle but Net60 needs CFO acknowledgment. Also need accounting treatment: record rebate as contra-revenue and release monthly.

Tom (RevOps): I'll open ticket ZOA-9007 to add the rebate charge type and Net60 payment term with a 50% holdback of rebate until month 2.

Diego (Sales): I'll get VAT ID and trade refs from SunRidge and route addendum for signature. ETA 24-48h.

accounts-bot: Note added to deal SUN-09: "3-month pilot: 10% usage rebate capped EUR6k, Net60 pending CFO, VAT passthrough pending VAT ID."

Harper (Legal): Drafted addendum, sending to Diego.

Amira (Finance): Conditional approval. Final sign-off after signed addendum and confirmation ZOA-9007 implemented. Please update thread when done.
